rejected.reason: JSON Schema cannot express sorted-array order or a SHA-256 identifier derived from sibling fields; the strict loader remains authoritative and is tested.
Version and semver metadata are ancillary renderings of an acknowledged compat mismatch, not independently baselineable integrity failures.
Parser diagnostics redact source content, while semantic validation must identify the invalid field, provider, source mode, or path so users can repair it.
The required text described a race-time refusal, but an already-present reparse point is safely refused earlier with a more accurate diagnostic.
The optional JSON Schema engine intentionally adds diagnostics; installation does not change the accept-or-reject verdict or remove dependency-free errors.
